questions.text: T he perimeter of one face of a cube is 40 cm. Its volume will be:
A and B complete a work in 12 and 15 days, respectively. T hey started the work alternatively for 1 day each and A started the work first. In how much time will 60% of the work be completed?
Rashid sells a book at a gain of 20%. If he had sold it at ₹34.51 more, he would have gained 37%. T he cost price (in ₹) of the book is:
T he lateral surface area of a cone is 550cm 2 . If the diameter of the cone is 14cm, then the height of the cone is:

In an educational institution, the ratio of the numbers of students in middle school and in high school, respectively, in a given year was given as 4 : 3. If there were 324 students in middle school in that year in that institution, what was the number of students in high school in the same year in that institution?

T he marked price of a fancy toy is ₹30,000. It is to be sold allowing two successive discounts of 20% and 24%, respectively. On cash payment, an additional 10% discount on the net price is also given. T he selling price (in ₹) of the toy is:

In a Panchayat election, three contestants - A, B, and C - are contesting. 75% of the total population of 8000 cast their votes. T here were no invalid or NOTA votes in the election. A got the least votes, with only 300 votes. B got 66% of the total votes and won the election. How many votes did B get?

Rohan buys a bike priced at ₹95,000. He pays ₹25,000 at once and the rest after 18 months, on which he is charged a simple interest at the rate of 10% per annum. T he total amount (in ₹) he pays for the bike is:
T he number 10000 is exactly divisible by which of the following numbers?
Find the average of all prime numbers between 42 and 75.

In a circular path of 619 m, Preeti and Rani start walking in opposite directions from the same point at the speed of 2.85 km/h and 5.4 km/h, respectively. When they will meet for the first time approximately?
Find the average of 642, 253, 834 and 303.

An iron costing ₹758 was sold by Ramesh at a gain of 15%, and it was again sold by Reena, who bought it from Ramesh, at a loss of 8%. Find the selling price of the iron for Reena (correct to two places of decimals).
T he price of a trouser is first decreased by 12% and then increased by 15%. If the initial price of the trouser was ₹1,500, find the final price (in ₹) of the trouser.
If 28 men can do a piece of work in 26 days, then in how many days 13 men will do it?
Rameshwar sold a bike at a loss of 15%. If the selling price had been increased by ₹3,375, there would have been a gain of 12%. Find the cost price of the bike.
If the length of each of the two equal sides of an isosceles triangle is 15 cm and the adjacent angle is 30o, then the area of the triangle is:
A car covers the distance from Delhi to Gurugram at 60 km/h and returns at a uniform speed of 40 km/h. T he average speed of the car during the whole journey is:
A bank gives ₹1,500 as simple interest in one year on an amount of ₹60,000. What is the annual rate of simple interest (in percentage)?
In a college election between two rivals, a candidate got 30% of the total votes polled. He was defeated by his rival by 200 votes. T he total number of votes polled was:
Find the amount of equal annual instalment, which will discharge a debt of Rs.40,376 due in 4 years at the rate of 2% p.a. simple interest.
Which of the following numbers is divisible by 11?

A chemistry laboratory requests for a 25% solution of ferrous sulphate. A supplier has 40 millilitres of 20% solution. How many millilitres of 40% solution should be added to make it a 25% solution (correct to two decimal places)?
Find a single discount equivalent to the successive discount of 12%, 20%, 24%, and 32%. (Correct to two places of decimals)
A man walks 3 km and 200 metres in 25 minutes. What is his speed (in km/h)?
